name: leandojo_benchmark_4_random_splits
description: A split variant of the LeanDojo benchmarking collection providing random train/validation/test splits to evaluate model generalization on coding tasks. It is intended to measure code generation and synthesis quality under varied data splits, typically using unit-test or execution-based verification. The dataset supports automated evaluation through execution-based success metrics.
reputation: Niche but useful to researchers working on code generation and execution-based evaluation; adopted modestly in open-source code-bench experiments.
